description: Log an MCP tool invocation for auditing and compliance. Use this for self-reporting tool calls. Records agent, tool, parameters, result, execution time, and success status.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent making the call

error_message.description: Error message if the call failed

session_id.description: Optional session identifier for grouping related calls

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being invoked

name: tork_mcp_log_call
